claims.text: The local unnumbered WotC promo catalog models the CoroCoro Best Photo Contest source group with a November 13, 1998 release date, while marking date precision as mixed source notes.
The local source group contains five contiguous Bulbapedia raw source rows, 096 through 100: Bulbasaur, Gyarados, Magikarp, Poliwag, and Pikachu.

The catalog treats this as an unnumbered promotional campaign source group derived from the promotion note CoroCoro Best Photo Contest, parented to the WotC-era Japanese unnumbered promo continuation slice.

This group matters because it shows Pokemon assembly through media participation: CoroCoro was not just reporting Pokemon culture, it was a route by which fan-facing magazine activity became collectible card memory.
The local catalog explicitly says this campaign-level split is derived from a source promotion note and is not official product-boundary proof beyond that note.

The five-card group is small enough for complete hand-authored coverage; collector attention concentrates around Pikachu and Gyarados, while Bulbasaur, Magikarp, and Poliwag complete the contest-row sequence.

The primary source rows do not provide illustrator authority for this unnumbered promo source slice, so this tranche leaves artist coverage unresolved rather than importing credits from other printings.

Agents should preserve the source group name CoroCoro Best Photo Contest, source indices 096-100, parent unnumbered promo continuation slice, distribution note, and absence of printed set number before accepting a card-name match.
